description: This file is a CKEditor plugin for the 'Spell Check As You Type' (SCAYT) feature. It defines plugin initialization, configuration, context menu integration, and management of the SCAYT engine and instances within the editor.

methods.name: in_array
methods.description: Checks if a value exists in an array.

methods.name: loadEngine
methods.description: Loads the SCAYT engine script and initializes the plugin, handling different environments and asynchronous loading.

methods.name: parseUrl
methods.description: Parses a URL string into its path and filename components.

methods.name: setControlInfo
methods.description: Stores control-related information for a specific editor instance.

methods.name: isControlRestored
methods.description: Checks if the control state has been restored for an editor.

methods.name: markControlRestore
methods.description: Marks the control state as restored for an editor.

methods.name: setControlId
methods.description: Associates a control ID with an editor instance.

methods.name: getControlId
methods.description: Retrieves the control ID associated with an editor.

methods.name: setPaused
methods.description: Sets the paused state of the SCAYT control for an editor.

methods.name: isPaused
methods.description: Checks if the SCAYT control is paused for an editor.

methods.name: getScayt
methods.description: Retrieves the SCAYT instance for a given editor.

methods.name: isScaytReady
methods.description: Checks if the SCAYT engine is loaded and ready for a specific editor.

methods.name: isScaytEnabled
methods.description: Determines if SCAYT is enabled for a specific editor.
